p: kingdom of God come with power: When he will begin his kingdom through the preaching of the gospel: that is to say, after the resurrection.

And after six days Jesus taketh: The heavenly glory of Christ, which would within a short time be abased upon the cross, is confirmed by visible signs, by the presence and talk of Elias and Moses, and by the voice of the Father himself; all this occurred before three of his disciples, who are witnesses against whom there is no objection.
became shining: Did sparkle as it were.
afraid: They were beside themselves with fear.
And as they came down from: The Lord has appointed certain times for the publishing of the gospel.
kept that saying with themselves: Though just barely as it were.

questioning one with another what the: They did not question together concerning the general resurrection, which will be in the latter day, but they did not understand what he meant when he spoke of his own special resurrection.

And they asked him: The foolish opinion of the rabbis concerning Elias' coming is refuted here, which was that either Elias should rise again from the dead, or that his soul would enter into some other body.
And when he came to his: Christ shows by a miracle, even to the unworthy, that he has come to restrain the wrath of Satan.
teareth him: Vexes him inwardly, as the colic does.
saw him: As soon as Jesus had looked upon the boy that was brought to him, the demon began to rage in this way.
all things are possible to him: Christ can and will do anything for those that believe in him.
And the spirit cried: The nearer that the virtue of Christ is the far greater Satan rages.
And when he was come into: We have need of faith, and therefore of prayer and fasting, in order to cast Satan out of that which belonged to him.
passed through Galilee: He and his disciples together.
For he taught his disciples: Christ forewarns us with great diligence so that we should not be discouraged with sudden calamities; but man's slowness to understand is great.
And he came to Capernaum: Only humility exalts.
house he asked them: Where he was accustomed to make his home.
me: He not only receives me, but also him that sent me.
And John answered him: God, who normally works through ordinary means, works also extraordinarily as often as it pleases him. But an extraordinary means is tested by the doctrine and the effects.
And whosoever shall offend one of: God is such a severe avenger of offences that it is better to suffer anything else than to be an occasion of offence to any.
worm dieth not: Their worm who will be cast into that flame.
For every one shall be: We must be seasoned and sprinkled by God, so that we may be both acceptable sacrifices unto him, and also so that in our being knit together we may season one another.
salted with fire: That is, will be consecrated to God, being seasoned with the incorruptible word.
